tags.name: Interaction
tags.description: Legacy endpoints for managing and processing end-user interactions, superseded by the Experience endpoints and frozen with no new rules or behavior changes. For MFA, they support binding and verifying TOTP, WebAuthn, and backup codes, and skipping under an optional policy. Email/SMS MFA, adaptive MFA, trusted devices, requested ACR, `enabled: false`, and verifying an existing factor before binding a new one are not supported and not planned.
